description: This file contains shell script functions for testing Git hooks and push operations involving refs with mixed references, including setup, testing push workflows, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, setting up test scenario and verifying output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output, asserting equality.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares reference states in git repositories to expected references.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes and normalizes output for comparison, making results stable and understandable.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats output and saves it as expected output for later comparison.
